T:P2.1.text: About Us | American Financial Group, Inc.

T:P2.2.text: American Financial Group, Inc. is a holding company based in Cincinnati, Ohio and. Our insurance roots go back to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Today, through the operations of Great American Insurance Group, AFG is engaged in property and casualty (P&C) insurance, focusing on specialized commercial products for businesses. We are proud to provide insurance products that help businesses manage their unique financial risks and exposures.

T:P2.3.text: AFG’s Specialty P&C Group is comprised of over 35 diversified businesses offering a wide range of specialty commercial coverages in three major groupings: Property and Transportation, Specialty Casualty and Specialty Financial.

T:P2.4.text: Many of our businesses are among the top performers in their respective industries. Our business has entrepreneurial spirit at its core, with a focus on accountability. Business autonomy in our Specialty P&C operations facilitates agility in underwriting, claims and policy servicing, and enables these businesses to develop distribution strategies and relationships in the unique markets they serve.

T:P2.5.text: By following a consistent, opportunistic strategy over many years and changing economic conditions, we have outperformed market indices over the long term while effectively managing portfolio risk.

T:P2.6.text: With the power of generations behind it, AFG grows and changes with discipline and integrity. We're proud of who we are, where we've been and where we're going. Our industry is changing, and we continue to change as well.

T:P2.7.text: American Financial Group traces its history to 1959. In the early days, the Company was known as American Financial Corporation. At its inception, the Company’s principal business consisted of savings and loans. Although insurance and financial services have always been at the core of its businesses, nearly sixty-five years later, the Company has evolved into a holding company with over 35 market-leading insurance operations engaged in the sale of specialty commercial property and casualty (P&C) insurance across a variety of ...

C:P1.1.text: Bowhead Specialty | Specialty Insurance & Underwriting Experts

C:P1.2.text: Bowhead Specialty provides tailored specialty insurance solutions. Expertise in professional, casualty, & healthcare liability coverage.

C:P1.3.text: Tailored underwriting for standard and complex risks. We offer Directors & Officers, Management Liability, Cyber, and Errors & Omissions coverage on admitted and non-admitted paper, serving public, private, and not-for-profit organizations, including financial institutions.

C:P1.4.text: Broad casualty coverage with the expertise to handle complex, high-hazard risks. Our core industries include construction, hospitality, public entity, manufacturing, real estate, and environmental.

C:P1.5.text: Medical Malpractice, Management Liability, and Errors & Omissions coverage specifically designed for healthcare organizations, including hospitals, medical facilities, senior care providers, and managed care organizations.

C:P1.6.text: Surface promises are easy. Depth is earned. We deliver what others don’t.

C:P1.7.text: We created Bowhead Specialty with a clear-eyed view of the market, seeing opportunity where others pulled back.

C:P1.8.text: Bowhead blends deep expertise with advanced technology and first-class service to enable the underwriting of risks with varying levels of complexity. Our capabilities span a range of product lines that support our brokers’ needs.

C:P1.9.text: Amid declining capacity, mispriced risk, and retreating carriers, we saw the need for a better approach.

C:P1.10.text: A specialty lines company led by experienced underwriters, focused on quality risk selection, and grounded in a culture that values character as much as capability.

C:P1.11.text: We have a firm belief that underwriting excellence starts with people, so we built a team of respected industry veterans, united by a commitment to excellence and superior service.

C:P1.12.text: Bowhead can help you navigate your specialty insurance needs with clarity and confidence.

C:P2.1.text: About Us | Bowhead Specialty | Custom Specialty Insurance

C:P2.2.text: Learn about Bowhead Specialty, our mission, team, and custom insurance coverage solutions. We offer tailored primary and excess coverage.

C:P2.3.text: At Bowhead Specialty, we aim to to make the complex manageable and the experience consistent for every client, partner, and employee.

C:P2.4.text: We do that by building with purpose: underwriting with precision, communicating with clarity, and operating with consistency from start to finish.

C:P2.5.text: We’re committed to a culture where collaboration transcends titles and departments. Every perspective is valued and ideas are strengthened through seamless partnerships across teams. By challenging one another with respect and celebrating shared wins, we create an environment of consistent growth and innovation.

C:P2.6.text: Brokers and insureds know exactly what to expect when they work with Bowhead Specialty: consistency, confidence, and care in the products and services we deliver.

C:P2.7.text: Bowhead Specialty provides tailored primary and excess insurance coverage solutions across multiple core divisions: Professional Liability, Healthcare Liability, and Casualty. Visit our appetite page for details of coverages offered.

C:P2.8.text: We serve a wide range of clients, from well-established public companies to growing private businesses and nonprofits. Our underwriters work to provide custom coverage for complex risks across multiple industries.

C:P2.9.text: We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all policies. Our underwriting-first model is backed by deep sector expertise, advanced analytics, and technology. Our core craft solutions are custom-built to meet the specific needs, risk profiles, and goals of our clients.
